verdict.rationale: Browserbase advertises spinning up thousands of concurrent browser sessions [docs-9]. Sessions can be created and controlled programmatically through the official SDK [docs-1, docs-22], and the product is positioned for data extraction and monitoring at scale, such as pulling data and tracking prices [docs-8, docs-12, docs-3]. The concurrency claim, however, rests on a single homepage marketing line rather than detailed documentation. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on concurrency limits, quotas and plan tiers; scaling or reliability guarantees such as retries and error rates; independent or hands-on corroboration of high-concurrency scraping.
